rationale: With only 20 minutes to close and the price sitting at 97.9% of today's range just $0.04 below the session high, the risk/reward for a long is poor — any failure to break the high results in immediate reversal risk with forced market-close liquidation. A short against the trend (price well above VWAP at $13.35, 9-EMA rising at $14.08) is equally unattractive given the strong intraday momentum. The last five 1-minute candles show tight, low-conviction consolidation near the high with no clear directional catalyst, making the probability of a meaningful move in either direction within the remaining window insufficient to justify the spread and execution risk.
